title: The Seven Valleys and the Four Valleys
author: Baha'u'llah
description: Baha'u'llah describes spiritual searching through the symbolic language of valleys and journeys. These mystical works explore love, knowledge, detachment and the transformations of the soul on its path towards the divine.
